translations.web: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
translations.bsb: So if I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another’s feet.
translations.kjv: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.
